verified: Actual keyboard typing lands at restored caret43 after a Plan switch and restart in WebKit and Chromium.
A pointer chooses its own caret instead of replaying the saved range, including when it cancels a queued focus task.
Later keyboard re-entry restores the most recent author caret rather than the original mount location.
Immediate key, paste, and IME composition events resume the pending range before input; deferred work does not overwrite a newer caret.
Focus task is cancelled on blur, pointer entry, unmount and scope change; current draft context is revalidated before relocation.
Exact evidence navigation focuses before applying its range; existing wide and narrow workspace journeys pass in both engines.
Explicit select-all, partial/accessibility selection and programmatic nonzero caret placement cancel pending bookmark replay; valid full-draft replacement does not append to old prose.
limitations: The browser restart uses document reload, not native process termination. Native force-quit checkpoints and verification are recorded separately by the parent task.
Browser fixture and unit cases use ASCII prose; location module also has an existing Unicode selection and unique-passage relocation regression.
